note: W6.3 (#842) dependency-BEHAVIOUR ledger. Every dependency that declares preinstall/install/postinstall is pinned here with a digest over its command strings AND the bytes of the local scripts it invokes, so a republished tarball that changes install behaviour under the same version fails the gate. Tighten-only: entries are removed when the dependency stops declaring a hook, never added to make a run green. Regenerate the shape with `node scripts/security/lifecycle-audit.mjs --print-ledger`, then WRITE A REAL REASON for each entry — a generated TODO reason fails the audit. `executes: true` is reserved for packages listed in the root package.json `trustedDependencies`; today none are, so none of this code runs at install time.

electron-winstaller.reason: script/select-7z-arch.js only copies the vendored 7z binary for the host arch out of the package's own vendor/ directory. No network, no spawn. Reviewed 2026-08 for #842 W6.3.

esbuild.reason: install.js downloads the platform-native esbuild binary over https (falling back to `npm install` of the platform package). This is the canonical native-binary-fetch shape and is exactly why the package is NOT in trustedDependencies: Bun resolves the optional platform package from the lockfile instead, so the script never runs. Reviewed 2026-08 for #842 W6.3.

workerd.reason: Same esbuild-derived installer, fetching the workerd native binary (wrangler's runtime). Not in trustedDependencies, so the script never runs; the platform package comes from the lockfile. Reviewed 2026-08 for #842 W6.3.
